name: io.aicoachellavalley/local-decisions
title: AICV Local Decisions
description: Read-only Coachella Valley retreat, workspace, satellite-base and founder-support decision evidence plus business-preview discovery. Returns dated sources, conditional fit, constraints, unknowns and official operator handoffs. Does not contact, book, charge, check live inventory or guarantee recommendations. The mock action pilot is separate from these tools.

tools.name: resolve_local_intent
tools.description: Compare sourced retreat, workspace, satellite-base and founder-support options against structured requirements. Preserve group, lodging or workspace access/duration, budget scope, working setup, privacy, accessibility, location, requested/excluded entities and required official action. Return dated evidence, conflicts, unknowns and official handoffs; no booking or payment.

tools.name: search_business_previews
tools.description: Find public business-preview records by query and city. Catalog matches establish identity and provenance, not current suitability or availability.

tools.name: get_business_preview
tools.description: Retrieve a known business catalog record and its source or canonical preview link; does not fetch or remeasure its live website.
